We are a boutique design-build organization passionate about creating meaningful spaces that reflect Providence’s distinctive character. Whether it’s honoring the timeless charm of College Hill or contributing to the energy of downtown, we focus on building community and crafting spaces that inspire and endure. Our Work About us Contact Us Open Menu Close Menu The PROVIDENCE ARCHITECTURE & BUILDING Co. Our Work About us Contact Us Open Menu Close Menu Our Work About us Contact Us About Us We are a small but mighty interdisciplinary architectural and construction firm rooted in the heart of Providence, Rhode Island. From designing bespoke single-family homes to revitalizing overlooked urban spaces, we are passionate about creating places that reflect the city’s rich history and dynamic culture. Our team thrives on collaboration and design thinking, weaving Providence’s unique character into every project. Whether it’s honoring the timeless charm of College Hill or contributing to the energy of downtown, we focus on building community and crafting spaces that inspire and endure. For us, it’s about creating meaningful environments that tell a story and connect people to the places they call home. We are an affiliate company of The Providence Group, a design-centered real estate development firm specializing in activating urban places, further enhancing our commitment to transforming spaces and fostering vibrant communities.
